brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: a base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: Full base at 0,0,0 and half base at 1,0,0 and full base at 0,1,0 provide base. Bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2-compartment full-depth) and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-half both removable tray bins.
notch:0#-1,1#notch0 with stem hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf provides notch drawer frame between the two full cells at 0,0,0 and 0,1,0
handle:0,0,0;top on cover at 0,0,0 top face

finish.summary: Portable organizer built on 2.5 cells with bins for small parts, notch drawer, and top carry handle. Mesh clash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
